points.description: Leasing managers built Excel reports manually instead of focusing on portfolio decisions.

points.description: Missing real-time insight delayed renewals, vacancy marketing, and maintenance responses.

points.label: Predictive Models
points.description: Machine learning produced 12-month portfolio revenue forecasts and tenant churn risk scores.

points.label: On-Demand Metrics
points.description: Managers can query verified portfolio metrics in Microsoft Teams without compiling manual reports.

points.label: Trusted Figures
points.description: The AI agent and Power BI dashboards show the same system-validated figures.

points.label: Renewal Risk Visibility

points.label: Proactive Management
